strings.en: The Einst appearing even inside Bandock...
We managed somehow, though.
Now... I'd like to hear everyone's opinions on the enemy we just saw...
It's important. Captain Misumaru, please keep your line open as well.
Yes... This is about the Einst... right?
Yes.
Come to think of it, why were they hiding inside Bandock?
Yeah... That's the first thing to ask.
Are the Gaizok and those guys even connected, anyway?
The Gaizok, to destroy the evil in the universe,
were created long ago... by the Gaizokians, they said...
Then here's how it is. Dunno who or where they're from,
but that mystery enemy's like the Gaizok, callin' us Earthlings "evil"
and attackin' us.
No... us... evil...?
I thought so too... But is it really that simple?
...Right. The Aura Road, Jaburo... Too much of what they do is baffling.
Plus, they swarmed the ring meteor belt, and seemed to search Solomon...
They may have some other goal...
About that enemy, if Nanbu or Excellen were here,
we might have learned something, but...
Yes... And Excellen is...
For now, it would be wise to compile
whatever data we have for review.
Shaff, please.
Understood, Princess Romina.
Well, at least we cut off the Gaizok at the source. That's a relief, right?
Yeah. They were a pain, showing up outta nowhere and running wild.
We can relax a little, can't we?
So, where do we head from here?
Mass reading at close range.
Huh? Don't tell me it's the Jovians...?
Got it on our end too! Hm, just one...?
Big Bro, it's a great big boat!
What... a spaceship?
That's... the Dangaioh team's...
It's that phony old geezer!
Now, now, is that any way to greet someone you haven't seen in ages!?
Foul-mouthed as ever, aren't you?
It has been a long time, Dr. Tarsan.
Indeed. Glad to see you're well too, Princess Romina.
I see some new faces... but there's no time for introductions,
so let me get to the point.
If Dr. Tarsan rushed here... something must have happened on Earth.
Exactly, young man.
Your comrades' operation seems to have wrapped up,
and they want you back right away for what comes next.
So say that assault team's chief and the worrywart captain.
...From an outsider's view, they sure get described harshly...
W-Well, setting that aside... couldn't they have just sent a message?
There'd be a little lag, but...
Banjo seems to have realized...
They literally want us back "right away," then.
Right. The Radorio ship aside, your Earth battleship apparently
has a lot of trouble with teleporting. So, to be safe,
I'll send you near Earth with my warp beam.
Ooh, you're pretty nice, gramps.
Well, you've looked after Mia and the others, and thanks to you,
the Bunker's pursuers have partly lost track of us.
This much is no trouble at all. Ka-ka-ka!
I dunno... I just can't quite trust him...
True. But I think we can trust him while the Bunker's after him.
Understood... Then we'd better get ready at once.
Princess Romina, Captain Misumaru.
Got it. I'll put the ship on alert, just in case!
Then the Elshank shall do the same.
Dr. Tarsan, we leave it in your hands.
Yes, just leave it to me and rest easy.
...Hooray for convenient plot devices.
The world's often like that, Ruri.
Romina / Play Earth route (Gandor Team) / Play Moon route (Ra Cailum Team)
